newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX CONFIRMS OVERMARS TO JOIN ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX CONFIRMS OVERMARS TO JOIN ARSENAL.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam winger Marc Overmars will move to English premier league side Arsenal next season, Ajax said in a statement on Tuesday.
Overmars, who played 111 matches for Ajax over five years, scoring 35 goals, will become the second Dutch international at Arsenal, joining striker Dennis Bergkamp.
No financial details were disclosed but media have estimated the transfer fee would be around seven million pounds.
Dutch news agency ANP said earlier on Tuesday Overmars would sign a five-year contract with the London club.
